Start: ai-proxy [--restart] [configuration options]
  --restart  Gracefully replace the owned proxy instance, waiting for its exit.
USAGE:
    ai-proxy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    ai-proxy harness claude -- --model opus

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    gain                    Show estimated initial-request token reductions and 
                            history                                             
    mcp                     Run the retrieval MCP server over stdio             
    harness <EXECUTABLE>    Launch a harness executable through the running     
                            proxy

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Show estimated initial-request token reductions and history

USAGE:
    ai-proxy gain [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                 DEFAULT                                        
    -h, --help                                             Prints help          
                                                           information          
    -p, --project                                          Filter to the current
                                                           project directory    
    -f, --format <FORMAT>        text                      Output format: text, 
                                                           json, csv            
        --endpoint <URL>         http://127.0.0.1:17432                         
    -g, --graph                                            Show an ASCII graph  
                                                           of daily estimated   
                                                           savings              
    -H, --history                                          Show recent provider 
                                                           request history      
    -d, --daily                                            Show daily totals    
                                                           (UTC)                
    -w, --weekly                                           Show Monday-start    
                                                           weekly totals (UTC)  
    -m, --monthly                                          Show monthly totals  
                                                           (UTC)                
    -a, --all                                              Show daily, weekly   
                                                           and monthly totals   
    -F, --failures                                         Show recorded proxy  
                                                           failures             
        --recalls                                          Show re
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Launch a harness executable through the running proxy

USAGE:
    ai-proxy harness <EXECUTABLE> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    ai-proxy harness claude -- --model opus

ARGUMENTS:
    <EXECUTABLE>    Harness executable to launch

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information                             
        --proxy <URL>       HTTP proxy URL (defaults to loopback and Proxy:Port 
                            or default port)                                    
        --ca-file <PATH>    Root CA PEM file (defaults to                       
                            ~/.ai-proxy/root-ca.pem)
